pages.title: AIVI Labs — Know exactly what AI says about your business
pages.description: We ask the questions your customers ask, hundreds or thousands of times, and show you where you're named, where you're not, and which websites the AI is reading.

pages.title: Get your own study — AIVI Labs
pages.description: A study of your business shows you what AI answers say about you and your competitors, measured properly, with the sources behind them.

pages.title: How we measure — AIVI Labs
pages.description: Every number we publish is a rate built from many repeated questions, not a screenshot.

pages.title: Dentists in two Ontario cities — AIVI Labs

pages.title: Toronto, neighbourhood by neighbourhood — AIVI Labs
pages.description: We asked ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's map for dentists in 186 areas of Toronto, more than 14,000 times.

pages.title: Where AI gets its answers — AIVI Labs
pages.description: We recorded more than 70,000 sources behind AI answers, and each AI turned out to read from its own shelf.

pages.title: Personal injury law across Ontario — AIVI Labs

pages.title: Ask twice: how consistent are AI answers? — AIVI Labs
pages.description: We asked identical questions thousands of times, on ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google.

pages.title: Coke or Pepsi? Two AIs pick. Two won't. — AIVI Labs
pages.description: We asked four AI assistants simple either/or questions about five famous brand rivalries, worded the way people really ask.

pages.title: About AIVI Labs
